baseline_definition: power_only_detection.defer_action uses only MW transitions for detection; action always requests missing verification and operator escalation from given notifications, without querying tools.
metric_definition: Event precision/recall, localization, classification, time and latency count task=detection only. Event match requires status, type, exact assets and source-tolerant time. Action status, gap, recommendation/prerequisite and structured communication scores start from GIVEN notifications; action_input_consistency is not detection credit. Cause/gap/classification mismatches fail with no private defaults or alternative cause allowance. Undefined ratios are null.
notice: One synthetic process test, not learning or demonstrated generalization. Holdout is inspected; no untouched holdout claim.
